apps.name: ASMR App
apps.subtitle: Browse & download ASMR works
apps.localizedDescription:
A modern iOS app for browsing and managing ASMR works.

Features:
• Browse latest ASMR releases
• Tag-based and keyword search
• CV autocomplete
• HLS stream downloads
• On-device translation
• Cloudflare bypass

versions.localizedDescription:
Stream, discover & storage

• Play a track straight from the work page without downloading it
• "More from this voice actor" on every work page
• Smooth placeholders while lists load
• Work images are shown in full, without empty space
• Settings → "Storage by Work": see what uses the most space and delete with a swipe
• Cache size in Settings is now correct and updates after clearing

Work pages & smarter downloads

• Tap a work in the Library to open its page: cover, tags, play/continue and all tracks with progress
• Tap a tag, voice actor or circle to search for more of their works
• "Download All" only downloads missing tracks and shows the overall progress
• Fixed: missing tracks of a partly downloaded work could not be downloaded
• Fixed: newly downloaded tracks only appeared after restarting the app
• Active downloads show the cover and work title
• Retry buttons when loading fails

Repeat, A-B loop & AirPlay

• Repeat a whole work or a single track (tap Repeat in the player)
• A-B loop: tap A-B to set the start, tap again to set the end – that part plays on repeat
• AirPlay button in the player to choose speakers or headphones

Faster start & better sleep timer

• Faster start: the security check now runs quietly in the background – the verification window only appears if you really need to tap something
• NEW shows the list from last time instantly while the new one loads
• Sleep timer fades out gently during the last 30 seconds
• New sleep timer options: "End of current track" and any custom duration

Continue where you stopped

• Every track remembers where you stopped and continues from there
• New "Continue Listening" row at the top of the Library
• Library shows how much of each work you have listened to ("Listened" when done)
• Multi-track works start with the track you played last
• Long-press a work → "Reset Listening Progress" to start over

Player on every tab

• The mini player now stays visible on every tab – keep control while you browse
• New floating mini player design
• Track list in the player: see all tracks and jump to any of them

Unified search bar

• Search and Library now share the same search bar and suggestion list
• Search keyboard: no autocorrect, "Search" button

Favorites fix & cleaner design

• Fixed: favorites were lost every time the app restarted
• Same colors for ratings and tags on every screen
• Favorites use a star everywhere
• Tag suggestions and Quick Filters start with real tags instead of years
• Stopping playback before deleting a work that is playing
• Less background logging – a bit faster and lighter

Search & status fixes

• Fixed: tag suggestions overlapped the "Search" title
• Settings now shows if the website is reachable ("Working") instead of always "Not Verified"

Verification fix & smoother scrolling

• Fixed: the security verification popup kept reopening in Search
• Typing # or @ now shows tags and voice actors right away
• "Verify" button in Search if verification is needed again
• Images are now decoded in the background – smoother scrolling

Faster & smoother

• App opens instantly, also offline
• Auto-play next track fixed

Enhanced Search UX

• Collapsible Quick Filters — hide when results showing
• Dynamic quick filters from server tags
• Rating filter chips (All/SFW/R-15/NSFW/extreme)
• Sort results: Relevance / Newest / Oldest
• Result count with filter awareness
• Inline recent search suggestions while typing
• Search syntax hints (#tag, @voice actor)
• Keyboard dismiss on scroll
• Compact horizontal selected tags strip

Major UI Overhaul

• Full Player: sleep timer, playback speed, track navigation
• Auto-play next track for multi-track works
• Search history and flow layout for tags
• Work Detail: rating badge, publish date, favorites, share button
• Settings: app version, storage size, metadata re-sync
• Downloaded indicator on results
• Swipe-to-delete always available
• Haptic feedback throughout

Metadata Refresh & Track Names

• Auto-refresh metadata for all downloads on app update
• Tracks now named 'Track 1', 'Track 2' instead of RJ code filenames
• Progress indicator during metadata refresh

Bug Fix

• Fixed CV name in Now Playing / lock screen showing too much text
• Improved metadata extraction from page content

Library Modernization

• Card-style library layout with visual hierarchy
• Sort library by date, name, or favorites
• Context menus for item actions (long-press)
• Rating badges (R-15, NSFW) on library items
• Now Playing shows actual artist/title
• Fixed tag count display bug
• Improved circle name extraction

• Fixed AltStore entitlement declaration
• Cloudflare bypass with WebView challenge
